"""The Harbor window: Start/Stop the server, open the photo browser, manage people, import folders."""

import json
import queue
import sys
import threading
import webbrowser
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Optional

from .atomic_file import write_atomic
from .database import OWNER_PROFILE
from .errors import HarborError
from .runner import RunningServer, ServerRunner

PREFS_PATH = Path.home() / ".photo-harbor" / "panel.json"
PREFS_VERSION = 1
DEFAULT_PORT = 8642
POLL_MS = 120

BG = "#f6f4f0"
CARD = "#ffffff"
INK = "#1d1f22"
MUTED = "#6b6a66"
LINE = "#ddd8cf"
ACCENT = "#1f6f6b"
ACCENT_DARK = "#185a57"
DANGER = "#a33a2c"


def load_prefs(path: Path, default_library: Path) -> dict:
    """Saved window choices; defaults when the file is missing, damaged or from another version."""
    prefs = {"library": str(default_library), "backup": "", "port": DEFAULT_PORT,
             "autostart": False}
    try:
        saved = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        return prefs
    if isinstance(saved, dict) and saved.get("version") == PREFS_VERSION:
        prefs.update({key: saved[key] for key in prefs if key in saved})
    return prefs


def save_prefs(path: Path, prefs: dict) -> None:
    payload = {"version": PREFS_VERSION, **prefs}
    write_atomic(path, json.dumps(payload, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8"))


def mask(key: str) -> str:
    return "•" * 8 + key[-4:]


class ControlPanel:
    """Builds the window; background work reports back through ``_inbox`` on the Tk thread."""

    def __init__(self, root, prefs_path: Path, default_library: Path) -> None:
        import tkinter as tk
        from tkinter import ttk

        self.tk, self.ttk, self.root = tk, ttk, root
        self._prefs_path = prefs_path
        self._prefs = load_prefs(prefs_path, default_library)
        self._runner: Optional[ServerRunner] = None
        self._running: Optional[RunningServer] = None
        self._inbox: "queue.Queue[tuple]" = queue.Queue()
        self._stop_import = threading.Event()
        self._importing = False
        self._style()
        self._build()
        root.protocol("WM_DELETE_WINDOW", self.close)
        root.after(POLL_MS, self._drain)
        if self._prefs["autostart"]:
            root.after(200, self.toggle_server)

    # ---------- look ----------

    def _style(self) -> None:
        root, ttk = self.root, self.ttk
        root.title("Harbor")
        root.configure(bg=BG)
        root.minsize(560, 640)
        style = ttk.Style(root)
        style.theme_use("clam")
        base = ("Segoe UI", 10)
        style.configure(".", background=BG, foreground=INK, font=base, bordercolor=LINE,
                        lightcolor=LINE, darkcolor=LINE)
        style.configure("Card.TFrame", background=CARD, relief="flat")
        style.configure("Card.TLabel", background=CARD)
        style.configure("Muted.TLabel", background=CARD, foreground=MUTED)
        style.configure("Head.TLabel", background=CARD, font=("Georgia", 13, "bold"))
        style.configure("Title.TLabel", background=BG, font=("Georgia", 20, "bold"))
        style.configure("Status.TLabel", background=BG, foreground=MUTED, font=("Segoe UI", 10, "bold"))
        style.configure("Card.TCheckbutton", background=CARD)
        style.map("Card.TCheckbutton", background=[("active", CARD)])
        style.configure("TEntry", fieldbackground=BG, padding=6)
        style.configure("TCombobox", fieldbackground=BG, padding=4)
        style.configure("TButton", padding=(12, 6), background=CARD)
        style.map("TButton", background=[("active", "#ece8e1")])
        style.configure("Accent.TButton", background=ACCENT, foreground="#ffffff",
                        font=("Segoe UI", 10, "bold"), padding=(16, 8), bordercolor=ACCENT)
        style.map("Accent.TButton", background=[("active", ACCENT_DARK), ("disabled", LINE)])
        style.configure("Horizontal.TProgressbar", background=ACCENT, troughcolor="#ece8e1",
                        bordercolor="#ece8e1", lightcolor=ACCENT, darkcolor=ACCENT)

    def _card(self, parent, title: str):
        frame = self.ttk.Frame(parent, style="Card.TFrame", padding=(18, 14))
        frame.pack(fill="x", pady=(0, 12))
        self.ttk.Label(frame, text=title, style="Head.TLabel").grid(row=0, column=0, columnspan=4,
                                                                    sticky="w", pady=(0, 8))
        frame.columnconfigure(1, weight=1)
        return frame

    # ---------- layout ----------

    def _build(self) -> None:
        tk, ttk = self.tk, self.ttk
        outer = ttk.Frame(self.root, padding=(20, 16, 20, 16))
        outer.pack(fill="both", expand=True)
        top = ttk.Frame(outer)
        top.pack(fill="x", pady=(0, 12))
        ttk.Label(top, text="⚓ Harbor", style="Title.TLabel").pack(side="left")
        self.status = ttk.Label(top, text="○  Stopped", style="Status.TLabel")
        self.status.pack(side="right")

        server = self._card(outer, "Server")
        self.library_var = tk.StringVar(value=self._prefs["library"])
        self.backup_var = tk.StringVar(value=self._prefs["backup"])
        self.port_var = tk.StringVar(value=str(self._prefs["port"]))
        self.autostart_var = tk.BooleanVar(value=bool(self._prefs["autostart"]))
        self._folder_row(server, 1, "Photo library", self.library_var)
        self._folder_row(server, 2, "Backup drive", self.backup_var, optional=True)
        ttk.Label(server, text="Port", style="Card.TLabel").grid(row=3, column=0, sticky="w", pady=4)
        ttk.Entry(server, textvariable=self.port_var, width=8).grid(row=3, column=1, sticky="w")
        ttk.Checkbutton(server, text="Start the server when this window opens",
                        variable=self.autostart_var, style="Card.TCheckbutton",
                        command=self._save).grid(row=4, column=0, columnspan=4, sticky="w", pady=4)
        buttons = ttk.Frame(server, style="Card.TFrame")
        buttons.grid(row=5, column=0, columnspan=4, sticky="w", pady=(8, 4))
        self.start_button = ttk.Button(buttons, text="Start server", style="Accent.TButton",
                                       command=self.toggle_server)
        self.start_button.pack(side="left")
        self.browse_button = ttk.Button(buttons, text="Open photo browser", state="disabled",
                                        command=self.open_browser)
        self.browse_button.pack(side="left", padx=(8, 0))
        self.address = ttk.Label(server, text="Start the server to see the iPhone address.",
                                 style="Muted.TLabel")
        self.address.grid(row=6, column=0, columnspan=3, sticky="w", pady=(6, 0))
        self.copy_address = ttk.Button(server, text="Copy", state="disabled",
                                       command=lambda: self.copy(self._running.lan_url))
        self.copy_address.grid(row=6, column=3, sticky="e", pady=(6, 0))

        self.people = self._card(outer, "People")
        self.people_rows = ttk.Frame(self.people, style="Card.TFrame")
        self.people_rows.grid(row=1, column=0, columnspan=4, sticky="ew")
        self.people_rows.columnconfigure(1, weight=1)
        self.new_name = tk.StringVar()
        self.new_entry = ttk.Entry(self.people, textvariable=self.new_name)
        self.new_entry.grid(row=2, column=0, columnspan=3, sticky="ew", pady=(10, 0))
        self.new_entry.bind("<Return>", lambda _event: self.add_person())
        self.add_button = ttk.Button(self.people, text="Add person", command=self.add_person)
        self.add_button.grid(row=2, column=3, sticky="e", padx=(8, 0), pady=(10, 0))

        imports = self._card(outer, "Import from this PC")
        ttk.Label(imports, text="Into", style="Card.TLabel").grid(row=1, column=0, sticky="w")
        self.target = ttk.Combobox(imports, state="readonly", width=24)
        self.target.grid(row=1, column=1, sticky="w")
        self.import_button = ttk.Button(imports, text="Import folder…", command=self.import_folder)
        self.import_button.grid(row=1, column=3, sticky="e")
        self.progress = ttk.Progressbar(imports, mode="determinate")
        self.progress.grid(row=2, column=0, columnspan=4, sticky="ew", pady=(10, 4))
        self.progress_label = ttk.Label(imports, text="Copies photos and videos in; the folder "
                                        "itself is not changed.", style="Muted.TLabel")
        self.progress_label.grid(row=3, column=0, columnspan=4, sticky="w")

        log_card = self._card(outer, "Activity")
        self.log_box = tk.Text(log_card, height=6, relief="flat", bg=BG, fg=INK, wrap="word",
                               font=("Segoe UI", 9), padx=8, pady=6, state="disabled")
        self.log_box.grid(row=1, column=0, columnspan=4, sticky="ew")
        self._set_running_ui()

    def _folder_row(self, parent, row: int, label: str, variable, optional: bool = False) -> None:
        from tkinter import filedialog

        self.ttk.Label(parent, text=label, style="Card.TLabel").grid(row=row, column=0, sticky="w",
                                                                     padx=(0, 12), pady=4)
        self.ttk.Entry(parent, textvariable=variable).grid(row=row, column=1, columnspan=2,
                                                            sticky="ew", pady=4)

        def choose():
            chosen = filedialog.askdirectory(parent=self.root, initialdir=variable.get() or None)
            if chosen:
                variable.set(str(Path(chosen)))
                self._save()

        self.ttk.Button(parent, text="Choose…" if not optional else "Choose… (optional)",
                        command=choose).grid(row=row, column=3, sticky="e", padx=(8, 0))

    # ---------- actions ----------

    def toggle_server(self) -> None:
        if self._runner is not None:
            self._stop_import.set()
            self._runner.stop()
            self._runner = self._running = None
            self.log("Server stopped.")
            self._set_running_ui()
            return
        try:
            port = int(self.port_var.get())
            if not 1 <= port <= 65535:
                raise ValueError(port)
        except ValueError:
            self.log("Port must be a number from 1 to 65535.", error=True)
            return
        library = Path(self.library_var.get()).expanduser()
        backup = Path(self.backup_var.get()).expanduser() if self.backup_var.get().strip() else None
        self._save()
        runner = ServerRunner(library, port, backup_to=backup,
                              log=lambda text: self._inbox.put(("log", text)), verbose=False)
        try:
            self._running = runner.start()
        except (HarborError, OSError) as error:
            self.log(getattr(error, "as_text", lambda: str(error))(), error=True)
            return
        self._runner = runner
        self.log(f"Server running. iPhone address {self._running.lan_url}")
        self._set_running_ui()

    def open_browser(self) -> None:
        if self._running is not None:
            webbrowser.open(self._running.local_url)

    def add_person(self) -> None:
        name = self.new_name.get().strip()
        if not name or self._runner is None:
            return
        try:
            added = self._runner.app.profiles.create(name)
        except HarborError as error:
            self.log(error.as_text(), error=True)
            return
        self.new_name.set("")
        self.log(f"Added {added.name}. Copy their key into their iPhone Shortcut.")
        self._refresh_people()

    def new_key(self, ident: str, name: str) -> None:
        from tkinter import messagebox

        if not messagebox.askyesno("New key", f"Give {name} a new key? Their current Shortcut "
                                   "stops working until it gets the new key.", parent=self.root):
            return
        self._runner.app.profiles.update(ident, new_key=True)
        self.log(f"{name} has a new key.")
        self._refresh_people()

    def import_folder(self) -> None:
        from tkinter import filedialog

        if self._importing:
            self._stop_import.set()
            return
        if self._runner is None:
            return
        folder = filedialog.askdirectory(parent=self.root, title="Choose a folder to import")
        if not folder:
            return
        profiles = self._runner.app.profiles.all()
        target = profiles[max(self.target.current(), 0)].id
        self._stop_import.clear()
        self._importing = True
        self.import_button.configure(text="Stop import")
        store, library = self._runner.app.store, Path(self.library_var.get()).expanduser()
        threading.Thread(target=self._import_worker, args=(store, Path(folder), library, target),
                         name="harbor-import", daemon=True).start()

    def _import_worker(self, store, folder: Path, library: Path, profile: str) -> None:
        from .importer import import_folder

        def progress(done, total, path):
            self._inbox.put(("progress", done, total, path.name))

        try:
            report = import_folder(store, folder, library, profile, progress, self._stop_import)
            self._inbox.put(("imported", report.summary, report.errors))
        except (HarborError, OSError) as error:
            self._inbox.put(("imported", getattr(error, "message", str(error)), ()))

    def copy(self, text: str) -> None:
        self.root.clipboard_clear()
        self.root.clipboard_append(text)
        self.log("Copied to the clipboard.")

    def log(self, text: str, error: bool = False) -> None:
        stamp = datetime.now().strftime("%H:%M")
        self.log_box.configure(state="normal")
        self.log_box.insert("end", f"{stamp}  {'⚠ ' if error else ''}{text}\n")
        self.log_box.see("end")
        self.log_box.configure(state="disabled")

    def close(self) -> None:
        self._stop_import.set()
        if self._runner is not None:
            self._runner.stop()
        self._save()
        self.root.destroy()

    # ---------- state ----------

    def _save(self) -> None:
        try:
            port = int(self.port_var.get())
        except ValueError:
            port = DEFAULT_PORT
        prefs = {"library": self.library_var.get(), "backup": self.backup_var.get(),
                 "port": port, "autostart": bool(self.autostart_var.get())}
        try:
            save_prefs(self._prefs_path, prefs)
        except OSError as error:
            self.log(f"Could not save window settings: {error}", error=True)

    def _set_running_ui(self) -> None:
        on = self._runner is not None
        self.status.configure(text="●  Running" if on else "○  Stopped",
                              foreground=ACCENT if on else MUTED)
        self.start_button.configure(text="Stop server" if on else "Start server")
        state = "normal" if on else "disabled"
        for widget in (self.browse_button, self.copy_address, self.add_button, self.new_entry,
                       self.import_button):
            widget.configure(state=state)
        self.address.configure(text=f"iPhone address  {self._running.lan_url}" if on else
                               "Start the server to see the iPhone address.")
        self._refresh_people()

    def _refresh_people(self) -> None:
        ttk = self.ttk
        for child in self.people_rows.winfo_children():
            child.destroy()
        if self._runner is None:
            ttk.Label(self.people_rows, text="Start the server to see and add people.",
                      style="Muted.TLabel").grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="w")
            self.target.configure(values=())
            self.target.set("")
            return
        profiles = self._runner.app.profiles.all()
        for row, profile in enumerate(profiles):
            ttk.Label(self.people_rows, text=profile.name, style="Card.TLabel").grid(
                row=row, column=0, sticky="w", pady=3, padx=(0, 16))
            ttk.Label(self.people_rows, text=mask(profile.key), style="Muted.TLabel").grid(
                row=row, column=1, sticky="w")
            ttk.Button(self.people_rows, text="Copy key",
                       command=lambda key=profile.key: self.copy(key)).grid(row=row, column=2,
                                                                            padx=(8, 0))
            if profile.id != OWNER_PROFILE:
                ttk.Button(self.people_rows, text="New key",
                           command=lambda p=profile: self.new_key(p.id, p.name)).grid(
                               row=row, column=3, padx=(8, 0))
        names = [profile.name for profile in profiles]
        current = self.target.get()
        self.target.configure(values=names)
        self.target.set(current if current in names else names[0])

    def _drain(self) -> None:
        """Apply messages from background threads; Tk widgets may only be touched here."""
        while True:
            try:
                message = self._inbox.get_nowait()
            except queue.Empty:
                break
            kind = message[0]
            if kind == "log":
                self.log(message[1])
            elif kind == "progress":
                _, done, total, name = message
                self.progress.configure(maximum=max(total, 1), value=done)
                self.progress_label.configure(text=f"{done} of {total}  ·  {name}")
            elif kind == "imported":
                self._importing = False
                self.import_button.configure(text="Import folder…")
                self.progress_label.configure(text=message[1])
                self.log(f"Import finished: {message[1]}.")
                for line in message[2][:5]:
                    self.log(line, error=True)
                self._refresh_people()
        self.root.after(POLL_MS, self._drain)


def main(library: Optional[Path] = None) -> int:
    """Open the window; returns when it is closed."""
    try:
        import tkinter as tk
    except ImportError:
        print(HarborError("the Harbor window needs tkinter", "this Python was installed without it",
                          "reinstall Python from python.org with 'tcl/tk' ticked, or use "
                          "`python -m photo_harbor serve`").as_text(), file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    from .__main__ import DEFAULT_LIBRARY

    root = tk.Tk()
    ControlPanel(root, PREFS_PATH, library or DEFAULT_LIBRARY)
    root.mainloop()
    return 0

        self.start_button.pack(side="left")
        self.browse_button = ttk.Button(buttons, text="Open photo browser", state="disabled",
                                        command=self.open_browser)
        self.browse_button.pack(side="left", padx=(8, 0))
        self.address = ttk.Label(server, text="Start the server to see the iPhone address.",
                                 style="Muted.TLabel")
        self.address.grid(row=6, column=0, columnspan=3, sticky="w", pady=(6, 0))
        self.copy_address = ttk.Button(server, text="Copy", state="disabled",
                                       command=lambda: self.copy(self._running.lan_url))
        self.copy_address.grid(row=6, column=3, sticky="e", pady=(6, 0))

        self.people = self._card(outer, "People")
        self.people_rows = ttk.Frame(self.people, style="Card.TFrame")
        self.people_rows.grid(row=1, column=0, columnspan=4, sticky="ew")
        self.people_rows.columnconfigure(1, weight=1)
        self.new_name = tk.StringVar()
        self.new_entry = ttk.Entry(self.people, textvariable=self.new_name)
        self.new_entry.grid(row=2, column=0, columnspan=3, sticky="ew", pady=(10, 0))
        self.new_entry.bind("<Return>", lambda _event: self.add_person())
        self.add_button = ttk.Button(self.people, text="Add person", command=self.add_person)
        self.add_button.grid(row=2, column=3, sticky="e", padx=(8, 0), pady=(10, 0))

        imports = self._card(outer, "Import from this PC")
        ttk.Label(imports, text="Into", style="Card.TLabel").grid(row=1, column=0, sticky="w")
        self.target = ttk.Combobox(imports, state="readonly", width=24)
        self.target.grid(row=1, column=1, sticky="w")
        self.import_button = ttk.Button(imports, text="Import folder…", command=self.import_folder)
        self.import_button.grid(row=1, column=3, sticky="e")
        self.progress = ttk.Progressbar(imports, mode="determinate")
        self.progress.grid(row=2, column=0, columnspan=4, sticky="ew", pady=(10, 4))
        self.progress_label = ttk.Label(imports, text="Copies photos and videos in; the folder "
                                        "itself is not changed.", style="Muted.TLabel")
        self.progress_label.grid(row=3, column=0, columnspan=4, sticky="w")

        log_card = self._card(outer, "Activity")
        self.log_box = tk.Text(log_card, height=6, relief="flat", bg=BG, fg=INK, wrap="word",
                               font=("Segoe UI", 9), padx=8, pady=6, state="disabled")
        self.log_box.grid(row=1, column=0, columnspan=4, sticky="ew")
        self._set_running_ui()

    def _folder_row(self, parent, row: int, label: str, variable, optional: bool = False) -> None:
        from tkinter import filedialog

        self.ttk.Label(parent, text=label, style="Card.TLabel").grid(row=row, column=0, sticky="w",
                                                                     padx=(0, 12), pady=4)
        self.ttk.Entry(parent, textvariable=variable).grid(row=row, column=1, columnspan=2,
                                                            sticky="ew", pady=4)

        def choose():
            chosen = filedialog.askdirectory(parent=self.root, initialdir=variable.get() or None)
            if chosen:
                variable.set(str(Path(chosen)))
                self._save()

        self.ttk.Button(parent, text="Choose…" if not optional else "Choose… (optional)",
                        command=choose).grid(row=row, column=3, sticky="e", padx=(8, 0))

    # ---------- actions ----------

    def toggle_server(self) -> None:
        if self._runner is not None:
            self._stop_import.set()
            self._runner.stop()
            self._runner = self._running = None
            self.log("Server stopped.")
            self._set_running_ui()
            return
        try:
            port = int(self.port_var.get())
            if not 1 <= port <= 65535:
                raise ValueError(port)
        except ValueError:
            self.log("Port must be a number from 1 to 65535.", error=True)
            return
        library = Path(self.library_var.get()).expanduser()
        backup = Path(self.backup_var.get()).expanduser() if self.backup_var.get().strip() else None
        self._save()
        runner = ServerRunner(library, port, backup_to=backup,
                              log=lambda text: self._inbox.put(("log", text)), verbose=False)
        try:
            self._running = runner.start()
        except (HarborError, OSError) as error:
            self.log(getattr(error, "as_text", lambda: str(error))(), error=True)
            return
        self._runner = runner
        self.log(f"Server running. iPhone address {self._running.lan_url}")
        self._set_running_ui()

    def open_browser(self) -> None:
        if self._running is not None:
            webbrowser.open(self._running.local_url)

    def add_person(self) -> None:
        name = self.new_name.get().strip()
        if not name or self._runner is None:
            return
        try:
            added = self._runner.app.profiles.create(name)
        except HarborError as error:
            self.log(error.as_text(), error=True)
            return
        self.new_name.set("")
        self.log(f"Added {added.name}. Copy their key into their iPhone Shortcut.")
        self._refresh_people()

    def new_key(self, ident: str, name: str) -> None:
        from tkinter import messagebox

        if not messagebox.askyesno("New key", f"Give {name} a new key? Their current Shortcut "
                                   "stops working until it gets the new key.", parent=self.root):
            return
        self._runner.app.profiles.update(ident, new_key=True)
        self.log(f"{name} has a new key.")
        self._refresh_people()

    def import_folder(self) -> None:
        from tkinter import filedialog

        if self._importing:
            self._stop_import.set()
            return
        if self._runner is None:
            return
        folder = filedialog.askdirectory(parent=self.root, title="Choose a folder to import")
        if not folder:
            return
        profiles = self._runner.app.profiles.all()
        target = profiles[max(self.target.current(), 0)].id
        self._stop_import.clear()
        self._importing = True
        self.import_button.configure(text="Stop import")
        store, library = self._runner.app.store, Path(self.library_var.get()).expanduser()
        threading.Thread(target=self._import_worker, args=(store, Path(folder), library, target),
                         name="harbor-import", daemon=True).start()

    def _import_worker(self, store, folder: Path, library: Path, profile: str) -> None:
        from .importer import import_folder

        def progress(done, total, path):
            self._inbox.put(("progress", done, total, path.name))

        try:
            report = import_folder(store, folder, library, profile, progress, self._stop_import)
            self._inbox.put(("imported", report.summary, report.errors))
        except (HarborError, OSError) as error:
            self._inbox.put(("imported", getattr(error, "message", str(error)), ()))

    def copy(self, text: str) -> None:
        self.root.clipboard_clear()
        self.root.clipboard_append(text)
        self.log("Copied to the clipboard.")

    def log(self, text: str, error: bool = False) -> None:
        stamp = datetime.now().strftime("%H:%M")
        self.log_box.configure(state="normal")
        self.log_box.insert("end", f"{stamp}  {'⚠ ' if error else ''}{text}\n")
        self.log_box.see("end")
        self.log_box.configure(state="disabled")

    def close(self) -> None:
        self._stop_import.set()
        if self._runner is not None:
            self._runner.stop()
        self._save()
        self.root.destroy()

    # ---------- state ----------

    def _save(self) -> None:
        try:
            port = int(self.port_var.get())
        except ValueError:
            port = DEFAULT_PORT
        prefs = {"library": self.library_var.get(), "backup": self.backup_var.get(),
                 "port": port, "autostart": bool(self.autostart_var.get())}
        try:
            save_prefs(self._prefs_path, prefs)
        except OSError as error:
            self.log(f"Could not save window settings: {error}", error=True)

    def _set_running_ui(self) -> None:
        on = self._runner is not None
        self.status.configure(text="●  Running" if on else "○  Stopped",
                              foreground=ACCENT if on else MUTED)
        self.start_button.configure(text="Stop server" if on else "Start server")
        state = "normal" if on else "disabled"
        for widget in (self.browse_button, self.copy_address, self.add_button, self.new_entry,
                       self.import_button):
            widget.configure(state=state)
        self.address.configure(text=f"iPhone address  {self._running.lan_url}" if on else
                               "Start the server to see the iPhone address.")
        self._refresh_people()

    def _refresh_people(self) -> None:
        ttk = self.ttk
        for child in self.people_rows.winfo_children():
            child.destroy()
        if self._runner is None:
            ttk.Label(self.people_rows, text="Start the server to see and add people.",
                      style="Muted.TLabel").grid(row=0, column=0, sticky="w")
            self.target.configure(values=())
            self.target.set("")
            return
        profiles = self._runner.app.profiles.all()
        for row, profile in enumerate(profiles):
            ttk.Label(self.people_rows, text=profile.name, style="Card.TLabel").grid(
                row=row, column=0, sticky="w", pady=3, padx=(0, 16))
            ttk.Label(self.people_rows, text=mask(profile.key), style="Muted.TLabel").grid(
                row=row, column=1, sticky="w")
            ttk.Button(self.people_rows, text="Copy key",
                       command=lambda key=profile.key: self.copy(key)).grid(row=row, column=2,
                                                                            padx=(8, 0))
            if profile.id != OWNER_PROFILE:
                ttk.Button(self.people_rows, text="New key",
                           command=lambda p=profile: self.new_key(p.id, p.name)).grid(
                               row=row, column=3, padx=(8, 0))
        names = [profile.name for profile in profiles]
        current = self.target.get()
        self.target.configure(values=names)
        self.target.set(current if current in names else names[0])

    def _drain(self) -> None:
        """Apply messages from background threads; Tk widgets may only be touched here."""
        while True:
            try:
                message = self._inbox.get_nowait()
            except queue.Empty:
                break
            kind = message[0]
            if kind == "log":
                self.log(message[1])
            elif kind == "progress":
                _, done, total, name = message
                self.progress.configure(maximum=max(total, 1), value=done)
                self.progress_label.configure(text=f"{done} of {total}  ·  {name}")
            elif kind == "imported":
                self._importing = False
                self.import_button.configure(text="Import folder…")
                self.progress_label.configure(text=message[1])
                self.log(f"Import finished: {message[1]}.")
                for line in message[2][:5]:
                    self.log(line, error=True)
                self._refresh_people()
        self.root.after(POLL_MS, self._drain)


def main(library: Optional[Path] = None) -> int:
    """Open the window; returns when it is closed."""
    try:
        import tkinter as tk
    except ImportError:
        print(HarborError("the Harbor window needs tkinter", "this Python was installed without it",
                          "reinstall Python from python.org with 'tcl/tk' ticked, or use "
                          "`python -m photo_harbor serve`").as_text(), file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    from .__main__ import DEFAULT_LIBRARY

    root = tk.Tk()
    ControlPanel(root, PREFS_PATH, library or DEFAULT_LIBRARY)
    root.mainloop()
    return 0

"""Open the Harbor window against the demo library, start the server, add a person, import, screenshot."""
import sys
import tkinter as tk
from pathlib import Path

from PIL import ImageGrab

sys.path.insert(0, r"C:\Users\Yunus-Emre\Desktop\portable_agent_kit\projects\photo-harbor")
from photo_harbor.control_panel import ControlPanel  # noqa: E402

HERE = Path(__file__).parent
prefs = HERE / "panel_prefs.json"
prefs.unlink(missing_ok=True)
root = tk.Tk()
panel = ControlPanel(root, prefs, HERE / "demo_lib")
panel.port_var.set("8733")
shots = []


def grab(name):
    root.update()
    x, y = root.winfo_rootx(), root.winfo_rooty()
    w, h = root.winfo_width(), root.winfo_height()
    ImageGrab.grab((x, y, x + w, y + h)).save(HERE / "shots" / f"panel-{name}.png")
    shots.append(name)


def step1():
    grab("stopped")
    panel.toggle_server()
    try:
        panel._runner.app.profiles.create("Ayşe")
    except Exception as exc:  # already exists on reruns
        print("create:", exc)
    panel._refresh_people()
    root.after(400, step2)


def step2():
    # Import a small folder through the same worker the button uses.
    folder = HERE / "import_src"
    (folder / "sub").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

"""Seed a demo library, serve it, and screenshot the gallery with Playwright (Edge)."""
import hashlib, io, math, random, shutil, sys, threading
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path

PROJECT = Path(r"C:\Users\Yunus-Emre\Desktop\portable_agent_kit\projects\photo-harbor")
sys.path.insert(0, str(PROJECT))
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFilter  # noqa: E402
from photo_harbor.app import HarborApp  # noqa: E402
from photo_harbor.config import load_or_create  # noqa: E402
from photo_harbor.http_server import HarborServer  # noqa: E402
from photo_harbor.records import UploadClaim  # noqa: E402

HERE = Path(__file__).parent
LIB = HERE / "demo_lib"
OUT = HERE / "shots"
PORT = 8711
PALETTES = [((242, 166, 90), (90, 60, 120)), ((120, 190, 220), (20, 60, 110)), ((250, 220, 180), (200, 90, 80)),
            ((140, 200, 140), (30, 80, 60)), ((230, 230, 240), (120, 130, 160)), ((255, 190, 200), (120, 70, 140))]


def picture(seed):
    rnd = random.Random(seed)
    a, b = rnd.choice(PALETTES)
    w, h = rnd.choice([(900, 1200), (1200, 900), (1000, 1000)])
    img = Image.new("RGB", (w, h))
    px = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    for y in range(h):
        t = y / h
        px.line([(0, y), (w, y)], fill=tuple(int(a[i] * (1 - t) + b[i] * t) for i in range(3)))
    for _ in range(5):
        r = rnd.randint(60, 260); x = rnd.randint(0, w); y = rnd.randint(0, h)
        px.ellipse([x - r, y - r, x + r, y + r], fill=tuple(min(255, c + rnd.randint(-40, 60)) for c in a))
    img = img.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(18))
    buf = io.BytesIO(); img.save(buf, "JPEG", quality=85)
    return buf.getvalue()


def seed(app_store):
    now = datetime(2026, 10, 24, 18, 0)
    n = 0
    for day in [0, 0, 1, 3, 9, 20, 41, 70, 130, 200, 380]:
        for k in range(random.Random(day).randint(2, 9)):
            data = picture(day * 100 + k)
            taken = (now - timedelta(days=day, minutes=k * 17)).isoformat()
            app_store.ingest(io.BytesIO(data), len(data), UploadClaim(f"IMG_{4000 + n}.JPG", hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), taken))
            n += 1
    print("seeded", n)


def main():
    fresh = "--fresh" in sys.argv
    if fresh and LIB.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(LIB)
    settings = load_or_create(LIB)
    app = HarborApp(settings, PORT)
    if fresh:
        from photo_harbor.catalog import Catalog
        from photo_harbor.store import PhotoStore
        seed(PhotoStore(LIB, Catalog(app.db)))
    server = HarborServer(("127.0.0.1", PORT), app.router, app.guard, verbose=False)
    threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True).start()
    from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright
    tag = next((a.split("=", 1)[1] for a in sys.argv if a.startswith("--tag=")), "now")
    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.launch(channel="msedge")
        for name, viewport, scheme, mobile in [("desktop", {"width": 1366, "height": 860}, "light", False),
                                               ("desktop-dark", {"width": 1366, "height": 860}, "dark", False),
                                               ("phone", {"width": 390, "height": 844}, "light", True)]:
            ctx = browser.new_context(viewport=viewport, color_scheme=scheme, device_scale_factor=2 if mobile else 1,
                                      is_mobile=mobile, has_touch=mobile)
            page = ctx.new_page()
            errors = []
            page.on("console", lambda m: errors.append(m.text) if m.type == "error" else None)
            page.on("pageerror", lambda e: errors.append(str(e)))
            page.goto(f"http://127.0.0.1:{PORT}/")
            page.wait_for_timeout(400)
            if name == "desktop":
                page.screenshot(path=str(OUT / f"{tag}-login.png"))
            page.fill("#login-key", settings.key)
            page.click("#login-form button")
            page.wait_for_timeout(1200)
            page.screenshot(path=str(OUT / f"{tag}-{name}.png"))
            for view in ("sync", "setup"):
                if name != "phone":
                    page.click(f"[data-view={view}]"); page.wait_for_timeout(400)
                    page.screenshot(path=str(OUT / f"{tag}-{name}-{view}.png"))
            if "--browse" in sys.argv:
                page.click("[data-view=photos]"); page.wait_for_timeout(300)
                months = page.locator(".rail-years .rail-item")
                print(name, "months in rail:", months.count())
                months.nth(2).click(); page.wait_for_timeout(700)
                page.screenshot(path=str(OUT / f"{tag}-{name}-month.png"))
                print(name, "month title:", page.inner_text("#scope-title"), page.inner_text("#scope-count"))
                page.fill("#search", "IMG_401"); page.wait_for_timeout(800)
                print(name, "search:", page.inner_text("#scope-title"), page.inner_text("#scope-count"))
                page.click("#scope-clear"); page.wait_for_timeout(600)
                if name == "desktop":
                    upload = HERE / "Tatil fotoğrafı.jpg"
                    upload.write_bytes(picture(999))
                    page.set_input_files("#upload-input", str(upload))
                    page.wait_for_timeout(1500)
                    print(name, "upload tray:", page.inner_text("#uploads-title"), "|", page.inner_text("#uploads-list"))
                    page.screenshot(path=str(OUT / f"{tag}-{name}-upload.png"))
                    page.locator(".tile").first.click(); page.wait_for_timeout(600)
                    page.screenshot(path=str(OUT / f"{tag}-{name}-viewer.png"))
            print(name, "errors:", errors or "none")
            ctx.close()
        browser.close()
    server.shutdown(); app.close()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import io
import sqlite3
import unittest

from photo_harbor.database import Database
from photo_harbor.errors import HarborError
from photo_harbor.importer import find_media, import_folder
from photo_harbor.journal import SYNC_DONE
from photo_harbor.profiles import ProfileBook, profile_id
from photo_harbor.records import PhotoFilter, UploadClaim
from tests.library_fixture import Library, sha

V1_SCHEMA = """
CREATE TABLE photos (sha256 TEXT PRIMARY KEY, rel_path TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, size INTEGER NOT NULL,
    original_name TEXT NOT NULL, media_type TEXT NOT NULL, taken_at TEXT, received_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    sort_time TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE events (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, at TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    sha256 TEXT, detail TEXT);
INSERT INTO photos VALUES ('%s', '2025/01/a.jpg', 3, 'a.jpg', 'image/jpeg', NULL,
    '2025-01-02T00:00:00', '2025-01-02T00:00:00');
INSERT INTO events (at, kind, detail) VALUES ('2025-01-02T00:00:00', 'sync_done', '2025-01-01T23:00:00');
PRAGMA user_version=1;
""" % ("a" * 64)


class ProfileBookTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.lib = Library(self)
        self.book = ProfileBook(self.lib.db, "owner-key-0123456789")

    def test_the_owner_profile_holds_the_library_key(self):
        self.assertEqual([(p.id, p.key) for p in self.book.all()], [("main", "owner-key-0123456789")])
        self.assertEqual(self.book.by_key("owner-key-0123456789").id, "main")

    def test_a_new_library_key_reaches_the_owner_profile(self):
        ProfileBook(self.lib.db, "rotated-key-0123456789")
        self.assertIsNone(self.book.by_key("owner-key-0123456789"))
        self.assertEqual(self.book.by_key("rotated-key-0123456789").id, "main")

    def test_ids_are_folder_safe_and_unique(self):
        self.assertEqual(profile_id("Ayşe Yılmaz"), "ayse-yilmaz")
        added = self.book.create("  Ayşe  ")
        self.assertEqual((added.id, added.name), ("ayse", "Ayşe"))
        self.assertEqual(self.book.by_key(added.key), added)
        with self.assertRaises(HarborError):
            self.book.create("AYŞE")
        with self.assertRaises(HarborError):
            self.book.create("!!!")

    def test_a_new_key_retires_the_old_one(self):
        added = self.book.create("Ayşe")
        renewed = self.book.update("ayse", new_key=True)
        self.assertIsNone(self.book.by_key(added.key))
        self.assertEqual(self.book.by_key(renewed.key).id, "ayse")
        with self.assertRaises(HarborError):
            self.book.update("main", new_key=True)


class MigrationTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_a_format_1_catalog_becomes_format_2_owned_by_main(self):
        lib = Library(self)
        path = lib.root / "old.sqlite3"
        old = sqlite3.connect(path)
        old.executescript(V1_SCHEMA)
        old.close()
        db = Database(path)
        self.addCleanup(db.close)
        self.assertEqual(db.conn.execute("PRAGMA user_version").fetchone()[0], 2)
        self.assertEqual(db.conn.execute("SELECT profile FROM photos").fetchone()[0], "main")
        self.assertTrue((lib.root / "old.sqlite3.v1.bak").exists())
        from photo_harbor.journal import SyncJournal
        self.assertEqual(SyncJournal(db).last_sync("main"), "2025-01-01T23:00:00")


class ProfileStorageTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_photos_land_in_their_profile_and_filter_by_it(self):
        lib = Library(self)
        claim = UploadClaim("IMG.JPG", sha256=sha(b"hers"), taken_at="2026-02-01T10:00:00",
                            profile="ayse")
        record = lib.store.ingest(io.BytesIO(b"hers"), 4, claim).record
        lib.put(b"mine")
        self.assertEqual(record.rel_path, "ayse/2026/02/IMG.jpg")
        found = lib.catalog.page(0, 10, PhotoFilter(profile="ayse"))
        self.assertEqual([r.sha256 for r in found], [sha(b"hers")])
        self.assertEqual(lib.catalog.stats("main").count, 1)
        self.assertEqual([m for m, _ in lib.catalog.outline("ayse").months], ["2026-02"])

    def test_last_sync_is_kept_per_profile(self):
        lib = Library(self)
        lib.journal.record("2026-10-24T10:00:00", SYNC_DONE, None, "2026-10-24T09:00:00", "ayse")
        self.assertEqual(lib.journal.last_sync("ayse"), "2026-10-24T09:00:00")
        self.assertIsNone(lib.journal.last_sync("main"))


class ImportTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.lib = Library(self)
        self.source = self.lib.root.parent / (self.lib.root.name + "_src")
        (self.source / "trip" / ".hidden").mkdir(parents=True)
        self.addCleanup(__import__("shutil").rmtree, self.source, True)
        (self.source / "trip" / "a.JPG").write_bytes(b"photo a")
        (self.source / "trip" / "clip.mov").write_bytes(b"video")
        (self.source / "trip" / "notes.txt").write_text("not media")
        (self.source / "trip" / ".hidden" / "b.jpg").write_bytes(b"hidden")
        (self.source / "copy.jpg").write_bytes(b"photo a")

    def test_finds_media_only_and_skips_hidden_folders(self):
        names = [p.name for p in find_media(self.source, self.lib.root)]
        self.assertEqual(names, ["copy.jpg", "a.JPG", "clip.mov"])

    def test_imports_into_a_profile_once_and_leaves_the_source_alone(self):
        steps = []
        report = import_folder(self.lib.store, self.source, self.lib.root, "ayse",
                               lambda done, total, path: steps.append((done, total)))
        self.assertEqual((report.stored, report.duplicate, report.failed), (2, 1, 0))
        self.assertEqual(steps[-1], (3, 3))
        again = import_folder(self.lib.store, self.source, self.lib.root, "ayse")
        self.assertEqual((again.stored, again.duplicate), (0, 3))
        self.assertTrue((self.source / "trip" / "a.JPG").exists())
        self.assertEqual(self.lib.catalog.stats("ayse").count, 2)

    def test_refuses_a_folder_inside_the_library(self):
        with self.assertRaises(HarborError):
            find_media(self.lib.root / "photos", self.lib.root)

-- **Context**: The user wants an iPhone to copy photos to their Windows PC whenever it is on the
-  home Wi-Fi, with no app installed, and to delete from the phone only what the PC really holds.
-  A web page cannot read the photo library in the background; Shortcuts automations can.
-- **Decision**: The phone side is two Shortcuts (sync and cleanup) documented in the gallery's
-  Setup tab, since unsigned `.shortcut` files cannot be imported on current iOS. The server is
-  Python standard library only (`http.server`, `sqlite3`). Each upload carries the phone's
-  SHA-256; the server streams to `.harbor/incoming`, hashes, keeps the file only on a match,
-  fsyncs and `os.replace`s it into `photos/YYYY/MM/`. `GET /api/has` re-hashes the stored copy
-  before answering `yes`. The catalog and journal live in one SQLite file (WAL,
-  `synchronous=FULL`, `PRAGMA user_version` 1, unknown versions refused untouched), so
-  transactions replace the temp-file-and-replace protocol for that state. `config.json` uses
-  the atomic write with a `.bak`. Requests from non-private addresses are refused, and every API
-  call needs the library key. Pillow and pillow-heif are optional and imported only in
-- **Consequences**: Nothing is installed on the iPhone and nothing unverified can be deleted. The
-  cost is a manual Shortcut setup (about ten minutes), one confirmation tap per cleanup (iOS
-  enforces it), and a full re-hash per `has` query, which is slow for large videos. If
-  Shortcuts' Generate Hash ever hashes different bytes than it uploads, every upload is
-### ADR-002: Month/kind/name browsing and hashless browser uploads
-- **Context**: The user wants to browse the library on the web, not only scroll a single
-  timeline, and a way to add photos from a browser. Review screenshots also showed unfinished
-  rows with clipped corners, "Today" in English beside dates in the browser's language, and
-  setup panels hugging the left edge.
-- **Decision**: `GET /api/outline` returns months with counts and the video count;
-  `GET /api/photos` takes `month`, `kind` and `q` (a LIKE match on the original name, with `!` as
-  the escape character). The gallery shows these as a sticky sidebar, which becomes a chip row
-  under 900 px. Search spans the whole library. `POST /api/upload` accepts a percent-encoded
-  `X-Name` and no `X-Sha256`: the PC hashes what it received, so a browser upload is proven
-  against its own bytes, not a phone's. The date order is `X-Taken`, then EXIF DateTimeOriginal
-  via optional Pillow (`exif_dates.py`, injected into `PhotoStore`), then `X-Modified`. Tiles are
-  rounded individually, today/yesterday come from `Intl.RelativeTimeFormat`, and the Sync and
-  Setup views are centred at 920 px.
-- **Consequences**: Browser uploads skip the end-to-end hash check that Shortcut uploads get. A
-  dropped connection is still caught by the Content-Length check, and the cleanup only deletes
-  what `has` re-verifies. Without Pillow, browser-uploaded photos are dated by their file time,
-  which on an iPhone picker can be the time they were picked.
-### ADR-003: Self-repairing duplicates, download-only non-media, exclusive port, socket timeout
-- **Context**: A review of the browser milestone found five faults. A re-sent photo whose PC copy
-  had vanished or been damaged was answered `duplicate` and stayed broken. A new photo whose name
-  was still held by a catalogued but missing file was moved into place but never catalogued, so
-  every sync sent it again. An uploaded HTML or SVG file would render, and run scripts, on the
-  gallery's own origin. On Windows a second server could bind the same port without an error. A
-  stalled client held a server thread forever.
-- **Decision**: On a hash match, `PhotoStore` re-verifies the stored copy and, if it fails, puts
-  the verified upload back at the catalogued path and answers `stored`. `Catalog.add` raises on
-  a `rel_path` clash, and the store then tries `name-<sha8>` and `name-<sha256>`. `/media` serves
-  only `image/*` (not SVG) and `video/*` inline; anything else is
-  `allow_reuse_address` off on Windows. Handlers time out after 120 s, and a read error mid-upload
-  becomes the "upload stopped early" HarborError. A config whose `.bak` is also unreadable fails
-  with Error/Why/Fix instead of a traceback.
-- **Consequences**: A duplicate upload now costs one re-hash of the stored copy. A phone left
-  mid-upload for over two minutes has to retry.

+  shared photos are stored once under the first sender. Sync start/done and reports are kept per

### ADR-004: One profile per person, catalog format 2, import from disk
- **Date**: 2026-10-24
- **Status**: Accepted
- **Context**: The user asked for profiles and for uploading from the PC's disk. One library is
  shared by a household, and each iPhone should sync into its own person's space without a
  second server or a second library.
- **Decision**: The catalog moves to format 2. `photos` and `events` gain a `profile` column,
  and a `profiles` table holds `id` (folder-safe, from the name), `name` and a unique `key`.
  Format 1 is upgraded in one transaction after a SQLite backup copy to
  `catalog.sqlite3.v1.bak`; existing rows default to `main`. The library key in `config.json`
  is always the `main` profile's key, so existing Shortcuts keep working, and only that key may
  add people, issue new keys or upload for another profile (`X-Profile`). New originals go to
  `photos/<profile>/YYYY/MM`; older files are not moved. A SHA-256 stays globally unique, so
  shared photos are stored once under the first sender. Sync start/done and reports are kept per
  profile. `importer.import_folder` walks a folder (skipping hidden folders and the library
  itself), streams each media file through `PhotoStore.ingest` with the file's mtime as the
  fallback date, and never writes to the source. If another process catalogues the same bytes
  first, the placed copy is removed and the result is `duplicate`.
- **Consequences**: Profiles separate photos, not access: any valid key can browse everyone's
  photos, because this is one household. A photo both phones hold appears only in its first
  sender's profile. Re-keying `main` stays a PC-side action (`key --new`).

### ADR-005: Harbor window, background runner and double-click launchers
- **Date**: 2026-10-24
- **Status**: Accepted
- **Context**: The user asked for a server start button and a file that opens the photo
  browser, so no console is needed day to day.
- **Decision**: `runner.ServerRunner` starts `HarborServer` on a daemon thread and stops it,
  together with the optional daily backup. Both `serve` and the window use it. The window
  (`control_panel.py`, tkinter from the standard library) offers Start/Stop, Open photo
  browser, the iPhone address, people with Copy key / New key / Add person, Import folder…
  with progress and cancel, and an activity log. Worker threads reach Tk only through a queue
  drained on the Tk thread. Window choices persist in `~/.photo-harbor/panel.json` (version 1,
  atomic write; a damaged or unknown file falls back to defaults). `Harbor.pyw` opens the window
  without a console, and `Open Photo Browser.url` points at `http://localhost:8642/`. The server
  now ignores `ConnectionError` in `handle_error`, because Windows reports every idle keep-alive
  close as `ConnectionAbortedError` and printed a traceback for each one.
- **Consequences**: A Python without tkinter cannot open the window; `panel` prints
  Error/Why/Fix and `serve` still works. The `.url` file assumes port 8642. The window has no
  dark mode.

content.text:
All four requests are built and working; they aren't committed or pushed yet.

**Start button: `Harbor.pyw`.** Double-click it to open the Harbor window, with no console. It has:
- **Start/Stop server**, the iPhone address with a Copy button, and **Open photo browser**.
- **People**: everyone's key with **Copy key** and **New key**, plus **Add person**.
- **Import folder…**, with a progress bar and the option to stop.
- An activity log.

It remembers the photo folder, backup drive, port, and an option to start the server automatically when the window opens.

**Photo browser file: `Open Photo Browser.url`.** Double-click it to open the gallery at `http://localhost:8642`. It assumes the default port 8642.

**Profiles: one per person.**
- Your existing library key is now the **Main** profile's key, so a Shortcut you've already set up keeps working.
- Each person you add gets their own key for their own iPhone Shortcut. Their photos go to `photos/<name>/YYYY/MM`, and their sync status is tracked separately.
- The gallery has a **People** list (Everyone, Main, Ayşe…).
- Only the Main key can add people, issue new keys, or upload into someone else's profile.
- Any valid key can view everyone's photos.
- A photo that both phones have is stored once, under whoever sent it first.

**Upload from the disk:**
- **Import folder…** in the window, or `python -m photo_harbor import <folder> --profile <id>`.
- **Upload → A whole folder…** in a desktop browser. iPhone Safari can't pick folders, so it only offers photos there.
- Subfolders are included, non-photo files and hidden folders are skipped, the source folder is never changed, and running it again only adds new photos.

The photo catalog moves to a new format the first time it opens. Before upgrading, it saves a copy as `catalog.sqlite3.v1.bak`. Existing photos stay where they are and belong to Main.

**How I checked it:**
- All 74 tests and all 4 project checks pass.
- I drove the gallery in Edge at desktop and phone widths. Selecting a person, uploading into their profile, and the per-person keys and sync status all worked.
- I ran the Harbor window itself: starting the server, adding Ayşe, and importing a folder of 3 photos (running it again said "3 already in Harbor").
- Double-clicking `Harbor.pyw` opens a window titled "Harbor".

**Bugs found and fixed along the way:**
- The server printed a full error trace every time a browser closed an idle connection.
- Stopping the server during an import left the import button stuck.
- On the phone, the Upload button had moved to the wrong side of the search box.

The decisions are written up in ADR-004 and ADR-005. The window has no dark mode.

Should I commit and push this to the public GitHub repository?

"""Measure Harbor at GB scale: one big upload, a folder import (and re-import), a 50k-photo catalog."""
import hashlib, http.client, json, os, shutil, sys, time
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, r"C:\Users\Yunus-Emre\Desktop\portable_agent_kit\projects\photo-harbor")
from photo_harbor.importer import import_folder  # noqa: E402
from photo_harbor.records import PhotoRecord  # noqa: E402
from photo_harbor.runner import ServerRunner  # noqa: E402

HERE = Path(__file__).parent / "bench"
BIG_MB = int(os.getenv("BIG_MB", "2048"))
FILES, FILE_MB = 200, 5


def call(port, key, method, path, body=None, headers=None):
    conn = http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1", port, timeout=600)
    conn.request(method, path, body=body, headers={"X-Harbor-Key": key, **(headers or {})})
    r = conn.getresponse(); data = r.read(); conn.close()
    return r.status, data


def main():
    shutil.rmtree(HERE, ignore_errors=True)
    HERE.mkdir()
    lib = HERE / "lib"
    runner = ServerRunner(lib, 0, host="127.0.0.1", verbose=False)
    run = runner.start()
    key = runner.app.profiles.all()[0].key
    try:
        # 1. one big file
        big = HERE / "big.mov"
        block = os.urandom(4 << 20)
        digest = hashlib.sha256()
        with open(big, "wb") as f:
            for _ in range(BIG_MB // 4):
                f.write(block); digest.update(block)
        size = big.stat().st_size
        t = time.perf_counter()
        with open(big, "rb") as f:
            status, body = call(run.port, key, "POST", "/api/upload", f,
                                {"X-Name": "big.mov", "X-Sha256": digest.hexdigest(), "Content-Length": str(size)})
        up = time.perf_counter() - t
        print(f"upload {BIG_MB} MB: {status} {up:.1f}s = {BIG_MB / up:.0f} MB/s")
        t = time.perf_counter()
        status, body = call(run.port, key, "GET", f"/api/has?sha256={digest.hexdigest()}")
        print(f"has (re-hash {BIG_MB} MB): {json.loads(body)['answer']} {time.perf_counter() - t:.1f}s")
        t = time.perf_counter()
        conn = http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1", run.port, timeout=600)
        conn.request("GET", f"/media/{digest.hexdigest()}", headers={"X-Harbor-Key": key})
        r = conn.getresponse(); n = 0
        while True:
            chunk = r.read(8 << 20)
            if not chunk: break
            n += len(chunk)
        conn.close()
        dl = time.perf_counter() - t
        print(f"download {n >> 20} MB: {dl:.1f}s = {(n >> 20) / dl:.0f} MB/s")
        big.unlink()

        # 2. folder import and re-import
        src = HERE / "src"
        for i in range(FILES):
            d = src / f"d{i // 50}"; d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            (d / f"IMG_{i:04}.JPG").write_bytes(os.urandom(FILE_MB << 20))
        t = time.perf_counter()
        rep = import_folder(runner.app.store, src, lib, "main")
        imp = time.perf_counter() - t
        print(f"import {FILES} x {FILE_MB} MB: {rep.summary} in {imp:.1f}s = {FILES * FILE_MB / imp:.0f} MB/s")
        t = time.perf_counter()
        rep = import_folder(runner.app.store, src, lib, "main")
        print(f"re-import: {rep.summary} in {time.perf_counter() - t:.1f}s")
        shutil.rmtree(src)

        # 3. a 50k catalog
        cat = runner.app.store._catalog
        t = time.perf_counter()

class Thumbnailer:
    def __init__(self, cache_dir: Path, pillow=_load_pillow) -> None:
        self._cache = cache_dir
        self._pillow = pillow()
        self._lock = threading.Lock()

    @property
    def enabled(self) -> bool:
        return self._pillow is not None

    def preview(self, record: PhotoRecord, original: Path) -> Optional[Path]:
        """The cached preview, made on first request; None for videos or unreadable images."""
        if self._pillow is None or record.is_video:
            return None
        target = self._cache / record.sha256[:2] / f"{record.sha256}.jpg"
        if target.exists():
            return target
        image_mod, ops = self._pillow
        try:
            # hygiene: allow Pillow's Image.open reads binary image data, not text
            with image_mod.open(original) as image:
                image = ops.exif_transpose(image).convert("RGB")
                image.thumbnail((EDGE, EDGE))
                buffer = io.BytesIO()
                image.save(buffer, "JPEG", quality=QUALITY, optimize=True)
        except Exception:  # hygiene: allow Pillow raises many types for unsupported formats
            return None
        with self._lock:
            write_atomic(target, buffer.getvalue())
        return target

def __init__(self, root, prefs_path: Path, default_library: Path) -> None:
        import tkinter as tk
        from tkinter import ttk

        self.tk, self.ttk, self.root = tk, ttk, root
        self._prefs_path = prefs_path
        self._prefs = load_prefs(prefs_path, default_library)
        self._runner: Optional[ServerRunner] = None
        self._running: Optional[RunningServer] = None
        self._inbox: "queue.Queue[tuple]" = queue.Queue()
        self._stop_import = threading.Event()
        self._importing = False
        self._style()
        self._build()
        root.protocol("WM_DELETE_WINDOW", self.close)
        root.after(POLL_MS, self._drain)
        if self._prefs["autostart"]:
            root.after(200, self.toggle_server)

        self._folder_row(server, 2, "Backup (optional)", self.backup_var)
        ttk.Label(server, text="Port", style="Card.TLabel").grid(row=3, column=0, sticky="w", pady=4)
        ttk.Entry(server, textvariable=self.port_var, width=8).grid(row=3, column=1, sticky="w")
        ttk.Checkbutton(server, text="Start the server when this window opens",
                        variable=self.autostart_var, style="Card.TCheckbutton",
                        command=self._save).grid(row=4, column=0, columnspan=4, sticky="w", pady=4)
        buttons = ttk.Frame(server, style="Card.TFrame")
        buttons.grid(row=5, column=0, columnspan=4, sticky="w", pady=(8, 4))


def main(library: Optional[Path] = None) -> int:
    """Open the window; returns when it is closed."""
    try:
        import tkinter as tk
    except ImportError:
        print(HarborError("the Harbor window needs tkinter", "this Python was installed without it",
                          "reinstall Python from python.org with 'tcl/tk' ticked, or use "
                          "`python -m photo_harbor serve`").as_text(), file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    root = tk.Tk()
    ControlPanel(root, PREFS_PATH, library or DEFAULT_LIBRARY)
    root.mainloop()
    return 0

"""Starting with Windows, and the pieces that keep large libraries fast."""

import threading
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

from photo_harbor.autostart import Autostart, launch_command
from photo_harbor.errors import HarborError
from photo_harbor.importer import ImportLedger, import_folder
from photo_harbor.thumbs import PreviewWarmer
from tests.library_fixture import Library


class _FakeRunKey:
    def __init__(self):
        self.value = None

    def read(self):
        return self.value

    def write(self, command):
        self.value = command

    def delete(self):
        self.value = None


class AutostartTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_the_command_runs_the_launcher_windowless_at_startup(self):
        command = launch_command(Path("C:/Python/python.exe"), Path("C:/apps/Harbor.pyw"))
        self.assertTrue(command.endswith('Harbor.pyw" --startup'))

    def test_on_and_off(self):
        registry = _FakeRunKey()
        start = Autostart(registry, "run harbor", supported=True)
        self.assertFalse(start.enabled())
        self.assertTrue(start.set(True))
        self.assertEqual(registry.value, "run harbor")
        self.assertFalse(start.set(False))

    def test_other_systems_say_so(self):
        start = Autostart(_FakeRunKey(), "run harbor", supported=False)
        self.assertFalse(start.enabled())
        with self.assertRaises(HarborError):
            start.set(True)


class ImportLedgerTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.lib = Library(self)
        self.ledger = ImportLedger(self.lib.db)
        self.source = Path(str(self.lib.root) + "_src")
        self.source.mkdir()
        self.addCleanup(__import__("shutil").rmtree, self.source, True)
        (self.source / "a.jpg").write_bytes(b"photo a")
        (self.source / "b.jpg").write_bytes(b"photo b")

    def reads(self):
        """Run an import and return how many source files were actually opened."""
        opened = []
        real = self.lib.store.ingest

        def counting(stream, length, claim):
            opened.append(claim.original_name)
            return real(stream, length, claim)

        self.lib.store.ingest = counting
        report = import_folder(self.lib.store, self.source, self.lib.root, "main", ledger=self.ledger)
        self.lib.store.ingest = real
        return report, opened

    def test_unchanged_files_are_not_read_again(self):
        first, opened = self.reads()
        self.assertEqual((first.stored, len(opened)), (2, 2))
        again, opened = self.reads()
        self.assertEqual((again.duplicate, opened), (2, []))

    def test_a_changed_file_or_a_lost_copy_is_read_again(self):
        report, _ = self.reads()
        (self.source / "a.jpg").write_bytes(b"photo a, edited")
        record = self.lib.catalog.page(0, 10)[0]
        (self.lib.store.photos_dir / record.rel_path).unlink()
        _, opened = self.reads()
        self.assertEqual(sorted(opened), ["a.jpg", "b.jpg"] if record.original_name == "b.jpg"
                         else ["a.jpg"])


class _CountingThumbs:
    enabled = True

    def __init__(self):
        self.made = []
        self.done = threading.Event()

    def preview(self, record, original):
        self.made.append(record.original_name)
        if len(self.made) >= 3:
            self.done.set()
        return original


class WarmerTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_backfills_old_photos_and_takes_new_ones_skipping_videos(self):
        lib = Library(self)
        lib.put(b"old 1", name="old1.jpg")
        lib.put(b"old 2", name="old2.jpg")
        lib.put(b"clip", name="clip.mov")
        thumbs = _CountingThumbs()
        warmer = PreviewWarmer(thumbs, lib.catalog, lib.store, page=1)
        lib.store.on_stored = warmer.add
        warmer.start()
        self.addCleanup(warmer.stop)
        lib.put(b"new", name="new.jpg")
        self.assertTrue(thumbs.done.wait(5))
        warmer.stop()
        self.assertEqual(sorted(set(thumbs.made)), ["new.jpg", "old1.jpg", "old2.jpg"])
EOF

content.text:
Start with Windows is in, and I measured Harbor with large files and fixed the slow spots. Nothing is committed yet: this work and the previous round (profiles, Harbor window, disk import) are still local.

**Start with Windows**
- There's a **"Start Harbor when I sign in to Windows"** checkbox in the Harbor window, and the same switch is in the photo browser under **Setup → This PC**. Only the main key can change it.
- When Windows starts, Harbor opens minimised and starts the server straight away, so phones can sync without anyone opening it.
- Optionally it opens the photo browser too: tick **"Open the photo browser when the server starts"** in the window.
- It uses the standard per-user startup entry in Windows, so no administrator rights are needed.
- I tested it on your registry: switched on, checked, switched off. It's off now, so nothing changed on your PC.
- It starts when you sign in, not when the PC boots.

**Large files:** I measured first, then fixed what was actually slow. The big-catalog rows are with 50,000 photos.

| | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Importing the same folder again | 11 s per GB, every file re-read | under 0.1 s, nothing re-read |
| People list | 223 ms | 10 ms |
| Search by name | 344 ms | 14 ms |
| Import from disk | 66 MB/s | 97 MB/s |
| Upload of a 1 GB video | 169 MB/s | 188 MB/s |
| Download of a 1 GB video | 535 MB/s | 535 MB/s |

- Upload was already fine: the slow first measurement (76 MB/s) came from my test tool, not Harbor. Wi-Fi will be the limit in practice.
- Files are streamed, never loaded whole into memory, and single files up to 16 GB are accepted.
- Thumbnails are now made in the background: new photos first, then older ones. A big library scrolls without waiting for them.
- The browser uploads 3 files at once.
- A catalog from the previous version is upgraded automatically, and a backup copy is saved first.

All 82 tests and all 4 project checks pass. I checked the window and the Setup page with screenshots. The decisions are recorded in ADR-006.

**What I propose next, most useful first:**
1. **Put the library on a bigger drive.** Only about 14 GB is free on C:, which a few months of iPhone video will fill. Pick another drive with **Choose…** in the window. I could also add a "disk almost full" warning to the window and the gallery.
2. **Test the Shortcut on a real iPhone.** This is still the one part nobody has run end to end.
3. **A weekly integrity check** that re-reads the library and the backup copy and reports damaged or missing files, so you're warned before the phone's copy is deleted.
4. **Video thumbnails.** These need ffmpeg installed; right now videos show a placeholder.
5. **A tray icon** instead of a minimised window. This needs one extra package (`pystray`).
6. **Turkish interface.** Dates already appear in Turkish; the buttons and text don't.
7. **Favourites, albums and "on this day" memories** in the gallery.
8. **Access away from home** through Tailscale, private and with no port forwarding.

Should I commit and push both rounds to the public GitHub repository? And which of these should I do next?

Start working then Also people should be able to reach from local server to their photos. Also they should be able to change their passwords. Folder storage on windows should not be complex and easily understandable, they should be reachable without app too.

I'll take "Start working" as: build what you just asked for first, then the proposals that need no extra installs. Here's how I'll read the new requests; correct me if any is off:
1. **People reach their own photos:** each person signs in to the gallery and sees **their own** photos. The main profile sees everyone's.
2. **Passwords:** sign in with your name and a password. People change their own password; the main profile can reset anyone's. The iPhone Shortcut keeps using its key.
3. **Simple folders, usable without Harbor:** photos live in plain folders like `D:\Harbor\Ayşe\2026\2026-10\IMG_1234.HEIC`, readable in File Explorer with a short "how this is organised" note in the library. Harbor's own files sit in a hidden `.harbor` folder.

One consequence: if Ayşe and you both have the same photo, it must appear in both of your folders. I'll use an NTFS hard link: one copy of the data on disk, two folder entries, no extra space.

class PhotoStore:
    def __init__(self, library: Path, catalog: Catalog,
                 now: Callable[[], datetime] = local_now,
                 embedded_date: Callable[[Path], Optional[str]] = read_taken,
                 on_stored: Optional[Callable[[PhotoRecord], None]] = None) -> None:
        self.photos_dir = library / "photos"
        self._incoming = library / ".harbor" / "incoming"
        self._catalog = catalog
        self._now = now
        self._embedded_date = embedded_date
        self.on_stored = on_stored
        self._place_lock = threading.Lock()
        self.photos_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self._incoming.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        for stale in self._incoming.glob(".tmp_upload_*"):
            stale.unlink(missing_ok=True)

    def ingest(self, stream: BinaryIO, length: Optional[int], claim: UploadClaim) -> IngestResult:
        """Stream ``length`` bytes (None: until the stream ends) to disk; keep them only when the
        hash matches the claim. ``on_stored`` hears about every newly stored or repaired file."""
        result = self._ingest(stream, length, claim)
        if result.status == "stored" and self.on_stored is not None:
            self.on_stored(result.record)
        return result

    def _ingest(self, stream: BinaryIO, length: Optional[int], claim: UploadClaim) -> IngestResult:
        expected = normalise_sha(claim.sha256)
        self._check_capacity(length)
        tmp = self._incoming / f".tmp_upload_{uuid.uuid4().hex}"
        try:
            actual, size = self._receive(stream, length, tmp)
            if expected is not None and actual != expected:
                raise HarborError("the photo arrived different from what the phone sent",
                                  "the SHA-256 of the received bytes does not match the phone's",
                                  "nothing was kept; the next sync sends it again", status=422)
            return self._place(tmp, actual, size, claim)
        finally:
            tmp.unlink(missing_ok=True)

    def verify(self, sha256: str) -> bool:
        """True only when the catalogued file exists and its bytes still hash to ``sha256``."""
        record = self._catalog.get(sha256)
        if record is None:
            return False
        path = self.photos_dir / record.rel_path
        try:
            if path.stat().st_size != record.size:
                return False
            return hash_file(path) == sha256
        except OSError:
            return False

    def locate(self, sha256: str) -> Optional[tuple]:
        """``(path, record)`` of a stored original, or None."""
        record = self._catalog.get(sha256)
        if record is None:
            return None
        path = self.photos_dir / record.rel_path
        return (path, record) if path.is_file() else None

    def _check_capacity(self, length: Optional[int]) -> None:
        if length is None:
            length = 0
        elif length <= 0 or length > MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES:
            raise HarborError(f"an upload of {length} bytes was refused",
                              f"uploads must be 1 byte to {MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES} bytes",
                              "send the file as the request body with its Content-Length",
                              status=413 if length > 0 else 411)
        free = shutil.disk_usage(self._incoming).free
        if free < length + MIN_FREE_BYTES:
            raise HarborError("the PC's photo drive is full",
                              f"{free} bytes free, {length + MIN_FREE_BYTES} needed",
                              "free space on the library drive, then sync again", status=507)

    def _receive(self, stream: BinaryIO, length: Optional[int], tmp: Path) -> tuple:
        digest = hashlib.sha256()
        received = 0
        limit = MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES if length is None else length
        with open(tmp, "wb") as handle:
            while received < limit:
                try:
                    block = stream.read(min(CHUNK, limit - received))
                except OSError as exc:
                    raise HarborError("the upload stopped early", f"the connection failed: {exc}",
                                      "keep the phone on Wi-Fi; the next sync sends it again") from exc
                if not block:
                    break
                digest.update(block)
                handle.write(block)
                received += len(block)
            handle.flush()
            os.fsync(handle.fileno())
        if length is None and received == limit and stream.read(1):
            raise HarborError("an upload was refused", f"it is larger than {MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES} bytes",
                              "send files smaller than 16 GiB", status=413)
        if received == 0 or (length is not None and received < length):
            raise HarborError("the upload stopped early",
                              f"{received} of {length if length is not None else 'some'} bytes arrived",
                              "keep the phone on Wi-Fi; the next sync sends it again")
        return digest.hexdigest(), received

    def _place(self, tmp: Path, sha256: str, size: int, claim: UploadClaim) -> IngestResult:
        # The phone's date wins; then the date inside the file; then the browser's file date.
        taken = (parse_taken(claim.taken_at) or parse_taken(self._embedded_date(tmp))
                 or parse_taken(claim.modified_at))
        if taken is not None and taken.tzinfo is not None:
            taken = taken.astimezone()
        received = self._now()
        name = safe_name(claim.original_name)
        with self._place_lock:
            existing = self._catalog.get(sha256)
            if existing is not None:
                if self.verify(sha256):
                    return IngestResult("duplicate", existing)
                return IngestResult("stored", self._repair(tmp, existing))
            folder = self.photos_dir / claim.profile / month_folder(taken or received)
            folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            stem, suffix = Path(name).stem, Path(name).suffix
            # A name can be held on disk, or by a catalogued photo whose file is gone.
            for candidate in (name, f"{stem}-{sha256[:8]}{suffix}", f"{stem}-{sha256}{suffix}"):
                target = folder / candidate
                if target.exists():
                    continue
                replace_with_retry(tmp, target)
                fsync_dir(folder)
                record = PhotoRecord(
                    sha256=sha256,
                    rel_path=target.relative_to(self.photos_dir).as_posix(),
                    size=size,
                    original_name=claim.original_name[:255],
                    media_type=media_type(name),
                    taken_at=taken.isoformat(timespec="seconds") if taken else None,
                    received_at=received.isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
                    profile=claim.profile,
                )
                try:
                    added = self._catalog.add(record)
                except sqlite3.IntegrityError:
                    replace_with_retry(target, tmp)
                    continue
                if not added:
                    # Another process (a CLI import) catalogued the same bytes meanwhile.
                    target.unlink(missing_ok=True)
                    return IngestResult("duplicate", self._catalog.get(sha256) or record)
                return IngestResult("stored", record)
        raise HarborError(f"no free file name for {name}", "every candidate name is taken",
                          "rename the photo and send it again", status=409)

    def _repair(self, tmp: Path, record: PhotoRecord) -> PhotoRecord:
        """Put verified bytes back where a catalogued original went missing or was damaged."""
